description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named ChatSessionsSheet, which displays a list of chat sessions managed by OpenClawChatViewModel. It includes UI components to show session details, refresh the session list, and dismiss the view.

classes.name: ChatSessionsSheet
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents a list of chat sessions, with options to switch sessions and dismiss the view.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The SwiftUI view body that constructs the user interface, including a list of sessions with navigation and toolbar items.
